en.title: China's Desert Restoration: What Travellers Can Read
en.headline: Straw Grids, Shelterbelts and Solar Fields Are Not the Same Intervention
en.description: Learn what China's straw grids, shelterbelts and desert solar fields do, which conditions limit them, and how to observe without entering work zones.
en.heroAlt: Satellite view of photovoltaic fields on dunes in the Kubuqi Desert, Inner Mongolia
